item.title: Woman accused of plotting "major attack" on New York State Capitol building
item.description: A New York woman is accused of plotting "a major attack" on the state capitol building in Albany, authorities said Thursday.

item.title: Closing arguments in Lindsay Clancy murder trial expected next week
item.description: Day 17 wrapped early on Thursday in the trial against Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother who admitted to killing her three children. CBS News correspondent Shanelle Kaul has the details.

item.title: Trump and Michael Cohen hold first public conversation in 8 years
item.description: The rift between President Trump and his former ally, attorney and fixer Michael Cohen, may be on the mend because, after eight years of silence, they held their very first public conversation. CBS News White House reporter Olivia Rinaldi has more.

item.title: Here's why federal authorities are investigating Eric Swalwell for alleged sexual misconduct
item.description: The FBI seized former Rep. Eric Swalwell's electronic devices after serving warrants on a sexual misconduct probe, sources say. As state and local authorities prosecute most sex crimes, what got the federal government involved? CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson joins with analysis.

item.title: Former Obama campaign adviser on rise of democratic socialists, Democrats' midterm strategy
item.description: Democratic strategist Ameshia Cross, a former communications adviser on the Obama-Biden 2012 campaign, joins CBS News to discuss the divide between centrists in the Democratic Party and democratic socialists and the party's strategy going into the 2026 midterms.

item.title: Grief coach shares 3 ways to find joy after losing a loved one
item.description: Kate Doerge shared with Norah O'Donnell on "Healthful" her three tips on how someone can find joy after losing a loved one.

item.title: "Everything as it was": Explore the bedrooms of kids killed in school shootings
item.description: The families of nine school shooting victims opened their doors to Steve Hartman and photographer Lou Bopp, allowing them to document their children's bedrooms.

item.title: Self-described U.S. spy who infiltrated al Qaeda at risk of ICE deportation
item.description: The Trump administration is trying to deport a self-described CIA spy who infiltrated al Qaeda after 9/11 and won his permission to live in the U.S. by helping convict terrorists.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial closing arguments expected early next week
item.description: Testimony at Lindsay Clancy's trial ended early Thursday as closing arguments are expected next week.

item.title: Woman linked to ISIS arrested for planning bomb attack on New York state capitol
item.description: A 35-year-old woman has been arrested for plotting a "major attack" on New York's state capitol building in Albany. CBS News' Jake Rosen has more.

item.title: Invasive Joro spiders are "slowly spreading." Here's what to do if you see one.
item.description: The Great Smoky Mountains National Park told visitors Tuesday that invasive Joro spiders "may be hanging in a web near you."

item.title: Iran dismisses Trump's "economic D-Day" threat as more "failed policies"
item.description: Iran has shrugged off President Trump's threat to hit the Islamic Republic with an "economic D-Day" as a "doubling down on failed policies."

item.title: Coinbase CEO says CLARITY Act will prevent another FTX collapse
item.description: Brian Armstrong made the case for the cryptocurrency legislation, which is scheduled for a Senate vote in September.

item.title: ICE and Iran worked together to deport Iranians to Iran, new emails reveal
item.description: U.S. immigration officials and Iran quietly worked together to deport Iranians to Iran in late 2025 and early 2026, newly released emails show. CBS News' Camilo Montoya-Galvez has more.

item.title: Dan Green wins crowded GOP primary in Florida's 9th District
item.description: Green will face Democratic Rep. Darren Soto after gerrymandering reshaped the district to heavily favor Republicans.

item.title: FBI seizes Swalwell's devices, executes warrants in sexual misconduct probe
item.description: FBI agents executed search warrants targeting former Democratic Rep. Eric Swalwell and seized his electronic devices, two sources told CBS News.

item.title: The fight to protect Big Bend, one of America's last wild places
item.description: Months after Congress approved billions for infrastructure across one of the least-trafficked stretches of the southern border, bulldozers arrived at Big Bend National Park.

item.title: New details about Trump's plans for Kennedy Center and White House ballroom
item.description: The latest court filings in cases involving the Kennedy Center and the White House ballroom project detail the work being done at the two institutions.

item.title: Army to nix drone battalion set up to absorb lessons from Ukraine war
item.description: The decision to phase out the Army drone battalion comes amid tension between senior officers who envisioned the unit and the acting chief of staff of the Army.

item.title: FTC says "personalized pricing" based on consumer data could violate law
item.description: The FTC warned businesses against changing prices based on their analysis of a customer's personal data, which could violate consumer law.

item.title: Pilot killed as plane collides with police helicopter at airport, officials say
item.description: One person was killed and two Pennsylvania State Police troopers were injured when a small plane collided with a state police helicopter on the ground in central Pennsylvania, authorities said.

item.title: Democrats narrow 2028 convention finalists to 3 cities
item.description: The Democratic National Committee is on the hunt for the best host city for the 2028 Democratic convention.

item.title: Walmart says it is using $2.9 billion in tariff refunds to lower prices
item.description: The company told CBS News it will direct the refunds toward groceries and general merchandise.

item.title: Tulsi Gabbard shares story of husband's cancer diagnosis: "It was tough"
item.description: In a new video shared first with CBS News, Tulsi Gabbard said doctors discovered the cancer, a sacral chordoma, a rare tumor, after her husband, Abraham Williams, experienced back pain.

item.title: Fishermen missing for 5 days found alive floating on cooler in Pacific
item.description: A video shared by Mexican officials shows the fishermen inside a blue cooler as the container bobs on ocean waves.
